hazard: Driver suddenly needs much higher steering force and may not complete the manoeuvre, leaving the lane or road
scenario: Highway speed, driving through a curve
rationale: Serious or fatal injury possible at high speed; situation occurs sometimes; most drivers can still steer manually with effort

malfunction: Unintended assist torque without driver input
hazard: Vehicle steers by itself, causing lane departure or collision
scenario: Highway speed on a straight road
rationale: Fatal injury possible; situation is very frequent; drivers cannot react in time to an unexpected steering pull

hazard: Steering becomes too sensitive and the driver over-corrects, losing vehicle stability
rationale: Serious injury possible at high speed; frequent situation; most drivers can compensate

hazard: Higher steering effort while manoeuvring, driver may touch a nearby obstacle
rationale: Low speed means light injuries only; frequent situation; most drivers can cope with the effort

malfunction: Assist torque applied in the wrong direction
hazard: Steering moves opposite to the driver intention
scenario: Moderate speed, turn on an urban road
rationale: Serious injury possible; occurs sometimes; very hard to control a reversed steering reaction

hazard: Steering response lags during an avoidance manoeuvre
rationale: Serious injury possible; evasive manoeuvres are rare; most drivers can adapt

malfunction: Torque sensor reports an erroneously high value
hazard: Assist control applies unwanted torque to the steering
rationale: Serious injury possible; occurs sometimes; unexpected torque is hard to control

malfunction: Torque sensor signal drops out intermittently
hazard: Assist torque oscillates and the steering feels unstable
rationale: Severe injury possible; frequent situation; most drivers can keep control

hazard: Steering wheel stays turned after a corner and the driver must unwind it
scenario: Low speed turn at a junction or car park
rationale: Only light injuries possible; frequent situation; easy to control

hazard: Steering wheel snaps back and disturbs the driver input
rationale: Serious injury possible; rare combination; most drivers can hold the wheel

function: F4 Fault detection and driver warning
malfunction: Warning lamp not activated when assist is lost
hazard: Driver is unaware that assist is lost and is surprised by the high steering effort
scenario: Any drive after a latent assist fault
rationale: Severe injury possible; occurs sometimes; surprise makes control difficult

function: F4 Fault detection and driver warning
malfunction: False fault warning without a real fault
hazard: Driver is distracted or stops unnecessarily
rationale: Light injuries at most; occurs sometimes; easy to control

hazard: Vehicle is pushed out of its lane although the driver has not departed
scenario: Highway, straight road with lane keeping active
rationale: Serious injury possible; frequent situation; most drivers can override

malfunction: Overlay torque not released when the driver overrides
hazard: Driver cannot steer away from an obstacle against the overlay torque
scenario: Highway obstacle avoidance with lane keeping active
rationale: Serious injury possible; occurs sometimes; driver cannot override so control is very difficult
